name: deploy-watch
description: Status light for Render deploys in the status line, with a toast when one starts, goes live, fails or is canceled.

renderApiKey.title: Render API key
renderApiKey.description: A Render API key (Account Settings, API Keys). Read-only use: the mod only lists deploys.

serviceIds.title: Services to watch
serviceIds.description: Render service ids, separated by commas. Label one with name=id, for example api=srv-abc123,web=srv-def456.

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to ask Render for the newest deploy. At least 10.
